import awkward as ak
import numpy as np
from pocket_coffea.workflows import BaseProcessor


class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor with muon preselection and counting."""

    def object_preselection(self, variation: str):
        """Build MuonGood collection: pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = self.events.muon
        self.events["muon", "MuonGood"] = (
            (muons.pt > 15) & (np.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        )

    def object_counting(self, variation: str):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event."""
        good_muons = self.events.muon[self.events.muon.MuonGood]
        self.events["nmuon_good"] = ak.num(good_muons)
